turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm finally getting around to cleaning up my local dev environment. Can you help me clear out some old cache directories?
Sure, Alan. Which ones are you targeting? Usually `~/.npm` or `~/.cache` are good starting points for quick wins.
Yeah, just the pip cache for now. Also, while we're at it, do you remember how long TransE took on the small dataset last week?
Let me check the logs. It ran for about 15 minutes.
Right. And for the medium-sized graph I was testing, it only took 2 hours. I think I set the dimensions to 100 back then.
Understood. 2 hours at 100 dimensions. Noted for your reference.
Cool. Just clear the pip cache now please.
Lloyd, I'm setting up the new GPU cluster for the embedding experiments. The specs are way better than my laptop.
That's exciting! What hardware are we looking at?
A100s. I'm also upgrading the TransE config. I'm switching to 500–1000 dimensions for the large knowledge graphs.
Noted. 500–1000 dimensions is a significant jump from your previous settings.
Yeah, the trade-off is time. With these new dimensions, TransE training takes 4–9 hours on large knowledge graphs now.
Got it. 4–9 hours is the new benchmark for those large graphs.
Exactly. I also ordered a new mechanical keyboard, should be here tomorrow.
Nice! I hope the switches are smooth.
